title: Mixed Event — Connected Through SEKAI's Cherry Blossoms — Episode4 A New Spring Menu

meta.Event Outline: In the Empty SEKAI, Miku's words inspire a discussion among Kanade and the others about having a cherry blossom viewing party. Meanwhile, everyone in the other SEKAI is also planning ways to make the most of the season...

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Heya!
I came to hang out, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Len, welcome.
You're here later than usual.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...? Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The gang's all here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come sit with us, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, what's going on?
Is something happening today?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO and Rin called us in when we were passing by the cafe just now to try these new menu items.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ That's what's up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
New menu items?
Oh, these pink drinks...?!
And this looks like a dessert...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those are cherry blossom lattes and smoothies. KAITO's having some pancakes topped with cherry blossom ice cream.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow, that looks delicious...!
I wanna try some too! Um... I'll have what Luka's having!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
A cherry blossom latte?
Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks!
But no one told me that you'd come up with some new menu items, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course not. I just started making these the other day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I drew some inspiration from one of the photos Kohane showed me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really?
What kind of photo was it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
A budding cherry blossom.
The way it was just starting to turn pink was so beautiful that I felt compelled to make some drink based on that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! You can come up with new menu items just like that?! Way to go, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you. But I don't deserve all the credit. Rin helped out as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I came up with a bunch of ideas for her, like how they should look and stuff! Outside of that... I was sort of the taste tester.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
Not only do these look nice, but they're pink in a spring-like way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, exactly!
They're aesthetically pleasing and delicious!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's hard not to get excited about spring♪ Thank you both for making these, MEIKO, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. We did it, MEIKO! High five!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for helping me with these, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We came to visit.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you're all together. Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Great timing, you guys!
We have special spring menu items ready for you today, so give these a try♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, those look adorable! What are they? Can I get one of those pink drinks too, MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, they look good and scream, “Spring!” Hey, you have pancakes on top of drinks...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, ask for whatever you like!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: These are actually based on that photo you showed me the other day, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
That's incredible... You came up with these after seeing just that photo...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: These cherry blossom cookies look very good. Mind if I have some?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, here you are!
Cherry blossom smoothies for Kohane and An, cherry blossom pancakes for Akito, and cherry blossom cookies for Toya.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, this looks so yummy...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I love how they represent spring so well!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: These are good. Especially these strawberries...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: These are good too. Just the right amount of sweetness. Also, they've been cut beautifully to look like cherry blossom petals.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You hear that, MEIKO?! They love everything!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm glad.
It was worth all the effort.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget.
The cherry blossoms around the park in my neighborhood were in bloom.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wanna try having a little picnic when it's not too crowded?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, a picnic sounds great!
I'd love to go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
At the same time, I'm very jealous.
I wish we had some cherry blossoms over here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can see from Kohane's or someone else's phone, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's true, but don't you want to cut loose a little under some real cherry blossom trees?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I know how you feel!
It'd be so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: People who say that usually end up catching a cold the next day...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shiraishi, you said you went out looking for some cherry blossom trees in SEKAI the other day...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I did!
I didn't end up finding any that time, but do you think I missed some along the way...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I've taken quite a few walks around here but am yet to see any actual cherry blossoms...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, I want you all to experience this season as much as possible, so I plan on coming up with more cherry blossom-themed menu items...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! I'll keep helping too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yay!
I can't wait to see what you come up with, MEIKO♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm gonna try my best too!
What do you think we should make next?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (They all look like they're having so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Isn't there anything I can do for them, like MEIKO and Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I can't cook like MEIKO and she already has Rin taste testing for her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
At the same time, I'm very jealous.
I wish we had some cherry blossoms over here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shiraishi, you said you went out looking for some cherry blossom trees in SEKAI the other day...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I did!
I didn't end up finding any that time, but do you think I missed some along the way...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's it...!
I just have to see if there are any cherry blossoms in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's still a chance that there's a tree around here somewhere, and everyone will really love it if I do manage to find one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, time to go searching!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, I'm not seeing any at all...
Not many other trees either.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It'd be so much fun to have some of the cherry blossom stuff that MEIKO made while having a picnic together under some cherry blossom trees too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh?
What's that? Is it glowing...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a look!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's so sparkly...
Wait! This is a fragment of a feeling!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But what kind of feeling?
I'm kinda curious now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on...
We all just talked about having a picnic together...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is this about seeing cherry blossoms? Does this mean they'll get to see some real ones...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But if I touch this, I'd be the only one who gets to see them, right? Hmm... What if I just poked it? Would it let me get just a quick peek...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Walks really are the best way for me to come up with new menu items.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I'm glad everyone liked my cherry blossom-themed menu items so much, but what should I do next...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Something that'll give everyone the motivation to keep trying would be nice.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(Len...?
Why's he squatting? Is he looking at something...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len, what are you doing in a place like this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, MEIKO!
How did you...? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, what's going on?!
I didn't even touch it...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Huh?
Is that ball of light a...?
